recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Bail order reminder that personal liberty can’t be sacrificed for political vendetta: Pawan Khera - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pawan Khera**, a Congress leader, was granted anticipatory bail by the **Supreme Court** after allegations were made against him regarding his comments on Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma's** wife. The court found that the matter appeared to stem from political rivalry and granted pre-arrest bail with certain conditions.  **Abhishek Singhvi**, along with other legal representatives, defended Khera's liberty amidst threats and intimidation. The Congress hailed the decision as a victory for the rule of law, urging **Sarma** to reconsider his language and apologize.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court takes suo motu note of assault on woman advocate, issues directions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** took suo motu action in a brutal assault case involving a woman advocate in New Delhi, directing the Delhi Police Commissioner to hand over the investigation to a senior officer. The court also ordered the police to look into three hospitals' refusal of admission to the victim and investigate allegations against her husband's in-laws regarding the disappearance of her two minor children. **Manoj Kumar**, the alleged assailant, was arrested on April 26th after confessing to stabbing his wife on April 22nd during a family dispute.

recent_articles.title: A season to try and understand the people’s pulse - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sonia Gandhi** made her debut election speech in Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu on January 11, 1998, amidst a backdrop of political tension and the legacy of Rajiv Gandhi's assassination.  During the campaign, voters expressed their support for **Congress** through slogans like "Zindabad," while others displayed strong emotional ties to parties like the **AIADMK**, exemplified by an elderly woman who identified with the party's symbol despite its opposition.

recent_articles.title: AIADMK looks to defend Melur and Usilampatti, its southern strongholds - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite internal conflicts within the AIADMK, the party appears to be favored in Melur and Usilampatti constituencies.  Incumbent MLA Periyapullan (AIADMK) faces a challenge from former Congress MP P. Viswanathan in Melur, where caste consciousness is prominent. The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) and the Naam Tamilar Katchi (NTK) are expected to impact the outcome. In Usilampatti, I. Mahendran (AIADMK) faces off against P. Ayyappan (AIPTMMK) and T. Saravanakumar (Congress).  The election is likely to be influenced by caste dynamics and local political alliances.

recent_articles.title: National Herald case: Delhi High Court to hear on Monday ED plea against Sonia, Rahul - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Delhi High Court** will hear a case on Monday, April 20, 2026, where the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** challenges a trial court's refusal to take cognisance of its charge sheet against **Sonia Gandhi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and others in the National Herald-linked money laundering case. The ED alleges that these individuals conspired and laundered funds through Young Indian, a company they controlled, allegedly acquiring properties worth ₹2,000 crore from Associated Journals Limited (AJL), publisher of the National Herald newspaper.  The trial court's order stated that the agency's probe stemmed from a private complaint and not an FIR, arguing that cognisance cannot be taken on such complaints. The ED argues that this decision is flawed and undermines its efforts to prosecute money laundering cases.

recent_articles.title: Vem Narender Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vem Narender Reddy** and **Abhishek Manu Singhvi**, both from Telangana, were sworn in as Rajya Sabha MPs on Thursday.  After the oath-taking ceremony, **Reddy** met with **Sonia Gandhi** to express his gratitude for her selection.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Assembly election: Jayalalithaa would have opposed delimitation if she were alive, says Stalin - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M.K. Stalin**, DMK president, criticized the **AIADMK** for its lack of opposition to delimitation and accused the BJP of attempting to suppress the voice of southern states. He argued that the BJP's focus on delimitation during elections is a ploy to divert attention from pressing issues like gas cylinder shortages. **Stalin** compared the BJP's actions to the making of makkan beda, highlighting the deceptive nature of their intentions. He emphasized that Tamil Nadu should resist attempts by Delhi to control its political future and protect its rights.

recent_articles.title: Congress issues three-line whip to its Lok Sabha MPs; unlikely to back delimitation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** issued a three-line whip to its Lok Sabha members urging them to support the party's stance during the upcoming special session of Parliament, which will focus on amending the women’s reservation law and carrying out a delimitation exercise. The government plans to increase the strength of both the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 50%, reserving 272 seats for women lawmakers. **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and party chairperson Sonia Gandhi have expressed concerns about the timing of the special session, arguing that it is being held in the middle of an election campaign and that delimitation should be addressed separately.

recent_articles.title: Revanth sees ‘political motive’ in linking Women’s Bill with delimitation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Revanth Reddy** accused the **Union Government** of misleadingly linking the Women’s Reservation Bill with constituency delimitation to create a narrative that opposition parties are obstructing reforms. He argued that these issues should be discussed and implemented independently, highlighting the Congress party's long history of supporting women's empowerment.  He criticized the BJP for its lack of support for the bill and pointed out the absence of female leadership within the party since its inception in 1980.

recent_articles.title: Congress discusses women’s reservation law and delimitation; Kharge to meet other Opposition leaders for joint strategy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress Working Committee** (CWC) discussed the government's proposed delimitation exercise and women's reservation law implementation. The party plans to formulate a joint strategy for the upcoming special session of Parliament, aiming to implement the women's reservation law by 2029 and increase the strength of the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 50%.  **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Rahul Gandhi** expressed concerns about the proposed changes, emphasizing the need for wider consultation on delimitation. The party also criticized the government's move to implement a predetermined number of seats for women, arguing that it undermines proportional representation for other marginalized groups.

recent_articles.title: Sharan Prakash Patil takes umbrage at remarks by BJP leaders against Mallikarjun Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. Sharan Prakash Patil**, **Medical Education Minister**, criticized **BJP leaders** for making "irresponsible" and "disrespectful" remarks against **AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge**.  Patil condemned the comments, arguing that they are being blown out of proportion and comparing them to past instances of similar attacks by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on Congress leaders. He also questioned the basis for comparisons made by **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** against **Jawaharlal Nehru**, emphasizing the Congress's commitment to non-alignment and condemnation of aggression without supporting war.
